description: This file defines the AuthProviderExtraDetails entity class, which maps to the 'ohrm_auth_provider_extra_details' database table. It contains properties for identifying and storing additional details related to an OpenID authentication provider, including relationships to an OpenIdProvider object, and includes getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: AuthProviderExtraDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing additional authentication provider details used for OpenID integrations, mapped to the corresponding database table with fields for provider info and credentials.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the entity.

methods.name: setOpenIdProvider
methods.description: Associates an OpenIdProvider with this entity.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID stored in this entity.
